keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «모모는 닌자 고양이다(비밀)» 와 «배고픈 생쥐에게 치즈를 나눠 준다(착한 행동)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the secret (Momo is a ninja cat) and the kind act (Momo shares the cheese with the hungry mouse). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Momo the cat and a hungry mouse
At night, Momo puts on a black mask and is a ninja cat.

boxes.qen: What kind thing does Momo do?
boxes.a: She stops the mouse, but she shares the cheese because it is hungry.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why does Momo share the cheese with the mouse?
qs.qko: 모모는 왜 생쥐와 치즈를 나눠 먹나요?
evs: One night, a mouse steals cheese from the kitchen.
She sleeps on the sofa all day.
The mouse is very hungry, so Momo shares the cheese.
why: 생쥐가 너무 배고파 보여서 모모가 치즈를 나눠 줘요. «so» 앞이 이유예요.
The mouse is very hungry, so Momo shares the cheese.

qs.q: "By day, Momo is a lazy house cat." What does "By day" mean?
evs: She stops the mouse at the door.
But at night, she puts on a black mask.
The mouse is very hungry, so Momo shares the cheese.
why: 바로 뒤에 «But at night» 이 나와요. 밤과 반대인 «By day» 는 낮 동안이라는 뜻이에요.
The story says "But at night" next. "By day" is the opposite: in the daytime.

qs.q: Why does nobody know Momo's secret?
opts: The mouse takes her mask away.
She is a ninja at night and sleeps on the sofa in the morning.
evs: But at night, she puts on a black mask.
One night, a mouse steals cheese from the kitchen.
She stops the mouse at the door.
In the morning, Momo is asleep on the sofa again.
why: 모모는 밤에만 복면을 쓰고, 아침이면 다시 소파에서 자요. 그래서 아무도 몰라요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Momo is a ninja only at night, and in the morning she is asleep on the sofa again. You need both sentences.

ends: Momo and the mouse become secret ninja partners.
모모와 생쥐가 비밀 닌자 짝꿍이 된다.
Momo finds a lost kitten in the dark street.
모모가 깜깜한 골목에서 길 잃은 아기 고양이를 찾는다.

write.src: “I think <u>Momo is kind</u> because <u>she shares the cheese</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)

img.cover: In a moonlit kitchen, Momo, a fluffy gray cat with white paws and big green eyes, wears a black mask over her eyes and leaps high over the kitchen table in one silent jump, while a small brown mouse with big round ears runs toward the door holding a yellow piece of cheese.

scenes.1: At the kitchen door at night, Momo, a fluffy gray cat with white paws and big green eyes, wearing a black mask over her eyes, lands softly in front of a small brown mouse with big round ears, who stops in surprise with a yellow piece of cheese in its arms.
scenes.2: By the kitchen door at night, Momo, a fluffy gray cat with white paws and big green eyes, wearing a black mask over her eyes, sits next to a small brown mouse with big round ears, and they nibble pieces of yellow cheese together from a small plate, both looking happy.
